name: @plaud-linux/audio-monitor
description: Linux (PipeWire) implementation of the Plaud Desktop native AudioMonitor addon: meeting auto-detection, smart microphone and smart speaker selection (unofficial, not affiliated with PLAUD LLC)
author: Iurii Trukhin (also known as Yuri Trukhin)

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/api-surface.mjs test/selftest.test.mjs test/meeting-native.test.mjs test/meeting-browser.test.mjs test/mic-monitor.test.mjs test/speaker-monitor.test.mjs test/pipewire-restart.test.mjs
